title: 第六百一十一章 震撼星空巨人的起源第六百一十章 神域
lines: 当然，神域作为一个六级文明，也不可能一无是处。
近千万年的发展，让神域已经发展出了一套属于自己的文明体系，虽然根基仍然是信仰和神级科技，但也融合了科技文明的优势，其中种种强大之处，也是如今的光明神国比不上的。
一路上，经过了无数关卡，蓝芙笛和兰登才终于抵达了神域的核心星域，降落在了一座大型星港之中。
它几乎有一个恒星系那么大，巨大的运兵星舰进入这星港之中，就仿佛水滴入海，眨眼间就不见了踪影。
星港中央，有一座恢弘的巨大神宫遥遥伫立，在阳光下光辉流转，熠熠生辉，显得神圣异常。
星港边缘，有穿着白色长袍的神官和穿着短打的神国力士在不停忙碌，偶尔有天使拍打着洁白的翅膀从天空中飞过，所有力士立刻恭敬地匍匐行礼。
这里是神域的“地上神国”与凡人生活星域的分界点，说是星港，但实际上更像是神域社会的一处缩影。
“喂~那两个新来的，你们过来。”
蓝芙笛和兰登两人刚刚送走一批天使伤患，还没来得及休息，就听一个熟悉的傲慢声音从不远处传来。
兰登皱眉，下意识的扭头看去，果然见到了那个熟悉又讨厌的身影。
那是一个穿着轻薄的亮银甲胄，打扮得异常骚包的十二翼天使。他有着神域天使那标志性的金色长发，五官深邃，眼眸湛蓝，看上去矜贵又优雅。
“奥兰多，你又有什么事？”兰登不爽地瞪着他。
“注意你的措辞，要叫我‘奥兰多子爵’。”奥兰多傲慢地瞥了他一眼，随即一脸理所当然地命令道，“我最近有事脱不开身，下一趟任务你们两个替我去。”
“你的任务凭什么让我们替你？”兰登一听就炸了，“按规定，想要调班必须通告队长，由队长点头首肯。私下替班是绝对不允许的！”
奥兰多翻了个白眼，对这个死守规矩的二愣子很是不屑：“规定还不允许收谢礼，不允许伤患加塞呢~有人遵守吗？”
“你！”兰登气得跳脚，烦躁不已，“你不就是欺负我们两个刚来，没有靠山吗？你又不是我们的上级，凭什么……”
然而，他的话还没说完，就被旁边的蓝芙笛拦住了：“这是他们的地盘。多说无益。”
蓝芙笛朝着奥兰多点了点头：“我们帮你跑这一趟就是了。你把航程表和签印给我。”
“哼~算你们识相。”
奥兰多哼了一声，一脸“早就知道你们会屈服”的高傲表情。
随手把刚到手的签印和航程表丢给蓝芙笛，他就高昂着头，挎着他的礼仪银剑一步一晃地离开了。
兰登一脸憋屈。
他自幼就生活在规矩严谨的神教体系之下，接受的是最严格的训练和最严谨的秩序，还真是第一次体会这种充满浓浓贵族官僚风气的社会形态。
真是太糟心了~
蓝芙笛倒是没那么多感慨。
她正低头看着航程表。
蓦地，她眸光一闪，敏锐地察觉到了一丝不对。
星空巨人的祖地并不在星空巨人一族所属星域的中心地带，而是位于距离荒芜之域最近的一片星空之中。
这里是星空巨人一族的起源地。
它也曾经是无数星空巨人出生，生活的地方。在它最鼎盛的时候，这里曾经生活了超过十几亿的星空巨人。
然而，大约两千万年前，它在战乱中被摧毁了，星空巨人一族不得不举族迁徙，这片祖地也就因此荒废了下来。
而如今，这里已经成为了星空巨人一族的墓地，无数巨人英雄安息于此。历代巨人王的陵寝，也同样位于此地。
在星空中航行了几天后，青铜巨舰终于抵达了巨人祖地。但它并没有停下，而是穿过星空，继续朝祖地深处前进。
吴辉透过弦窗的水晶窗向外看去。
这里几乎没有成型的星球，没有恒星，没有行星，寂静深邃的虚空里，到处都是破碎的星球碎片。呼啸的能量风暴到处肆虐，时不时就会有星球碎片被呼啸的能量风暴裹挟着砸在星空巨舰上，溅起丝丝火花。
星空中，时不时还能看到空间塌缩未能恢复，从而形成的空间裂纹和褶皱，还有被特种能量轰击造成的永久性能量瘢痕。
战场上残余能量汇聚成的能量云如丝如雾，直至今天依旧存在于这片星空之中。
content_en:
…
Of course, as a sixth-level civilization, God’s Domain cannot be without merit.
After nearly ten million years of development, the Divine Realm has developed a civilization system of its own. Although the foundation is still faith and god-level technology, it also incorporates the advantages of scientific and technological civilization. Its various strengths are unmatched by today's Divine Kingdom of Light.
Along the way, after passing countless levels, Lan Fudi and Langdon finally arrived at the core star field of God's Domain and landed in a large star port.
It is almost as big as a star system. When a huge troop transport starship enters this star port, it is like water dropping into the sea and disappearing in the blink of an eye.
In the center of the star port, there is a magnificent and huge palace standing in the distance. It is shining and shining in the sunlight, looking extremely sacred.
At the edge of the star port, there were priests in white robes and warriors from the Kingdom of God in shorts who were busy. Occasionally, angels flapped their white wings and flew through the sky. All the warriors immediately prostrated respectfully and saluted.
This is the dividing point between the "God's Kingdom on Earth" of the God's Domain and the Star Realm of mortal life. It is said to be a star port, but in fact it is more like a microcosm of the society of the God's Domain.
"Hey~ those two newcomers, come here."
Lan Fudi and Langdon had just sent away a group of injured angels. Before they had time to rest, they heard a familiar arrogant voice coming from not far away.
Langdon frowned and subconsciously turned his head to look, and sure enough he saw that familiar and annoying figure.
It was a twelve-winged angel wearing thin bright silver armor and dressed extremely coquettishly. He has the iconic long golden hair of an angel from the divine realm, with deep facial features and blue eyes, making him look noble and elegant.
"Orlando, what's the matter with you?" Langdon glared at him unhappily.
"Watch your wording. You want to call me 'Viscount Orlando'." Orlando glanced at him arrogantly, and then ordered with a matter-of-fact expression, "I have been busy recently, so you two will go on my next mission for me."
"Why should you ask us to take over your mission?" Langdon was furious when he heard this. "According to the regulations, if you want to change shifts, you must notify the captain, and the captain will nod his approval. Private substitutions are absolutely not allowed!"
Orlando rolled his eyes and was very disdainful of this fool who adhered to the rules: "The rules do not allow accepting gifts of thanks, and the injured are not allowed to rush in. Is anyone following it?"
"You!" Langdon jumped angrily, irritated. "Aren't you just bullying us two who have just arrived and have no backers? You are not our superior, so why..."
However, before he could finish his words, he was stopped by Lan Fudi next to him: "This is their territory. Talking more is useless."
Lan Fudi nodded towards Orlando: "We'll just help you make this trip. Give me the itinerary and signature."
"Humph~ I guess you know each other."
Orlando snorted, with a haughty expression on his face that said, "I knew you would give in."
He casually threw the newly obtained signatures and voyage chart to Lan Fudi, held his head high, and left step by step with his ceremonial silver sword.
Langdon looked aggrieved.
He has lived under the religious system with strict rules since he was a child, receiving the strictest training and strictest order. This is the first time he has experienced this kind of social form full of strong aristocratic bureaucracy.
It’s so sad~
Lan Fudi was not so emotional.
She was looking down at the voyage chart.
Suddenly, her eyes flashed, and she keenly noticed something was wrong.
…
The ancestral land of the Starry Sky Giants is not in the center of the starry domain to which the Starry Sky Giants belong, but is located in the starry sky closest to the Desolate Domain.
This is the origin of the starry sky giant clan.
It was also the place where countless star giants were born and lived. At its peak, more than a billion star giants lived here.
However, about 20 million years ago, it was destroyed in a war, and the starry sky giants had to migrate as a family, and this ancestral land was therefore abandoned.
Now, this place has become the cemetery of the starry sky giant clan, and countless giant heroes rest here. The tombs of giant kings throughout the ages are also located here.
After sailing in the starry sky for several days, the bronze giant ship finally arrived at the ancestral land of the giants. But it did not stop, but moved through the starry sky and continued towards the depths of the ancestral land.
Wu Hui looked out through the crystal window of the string window.
There are almost no formed planets here, no stars, no planets. In the silent and deep void, there are broken planet fragments everywhere. Howling energy storms raged everywhere, and from time to time, planet fragments would be carried by the roaring energy storms and hit the giant starship, causing sparks to fly.
In the starry sky, from time to time, you can still see the space cracks and folds formed by the failure of space collapse to recover, as well as the permanent energy scars caused by the bombardment of special energy.
The energy clouds formed by the remaining energy on the battlefield are like threads and mist, and they still exist in the starry sky to this day.
title_en: Chapter 611: The origin of the giant that shook the starry sky Chapter 610: God's Domain
